definitions.explanation: A celebratory gathering with food and drink. Has an elegant, literary tone compared to the everyday word パーティー. Often used for formal or traditional celebrations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{盛大|せいだい}→盛大：13644_seidai⟧な{宴|うたげ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祝|いわ}う→祝う：01881_iwau⟧{宴|うたげ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The celebration of the victory continued until late at night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大広間|おおひろま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{華|はな}やか→華やか：06070_hanayaka⟧な{宴|うたげ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{催|もよお}され→催す：11517_moyoosu⟧、⟦{家臣|かしん}→家臣：12655_kashin⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: A splendid banquet was held in the great hall of the castle, and the retainers gathered.

notes:
USAGE:
A literary and elegant word. In modern Japanese, it is used in formal writing, historical narratives, and creative works more than in casual conversation. For everyday parties and gatherings, ⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧ or ⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧ are more natural.

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{宴会|えんかい}→宴会：04104_enkai⟧ is the more common compound for a banquet or dinner party and is used in everyday contexts (⟦{忘年会|ぼうねんかい}→忘年会：15800_bounenkai⟧, ⟦{歓迎会|かんげいかい}→歓迎会：15791_kangeikai⟧, etc.). {宴|うたげ} has a more poetic and literary feel.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宴|うたげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to hold a feast
- {宴|うたげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{催|もよお}す→催す：11517_moyoosu⟧: to host a banquet
- ⟦{盛大|せいだい}→盛大：13644_seidai⟧な{宴|うたげ}: a grand feast
- {宴|うたげ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧: the banquet table/occasion
